ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse, high-intensity (white) focal points comprising less than 5% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark grey/black field. High-contrast white ring-shaped geometric blobs (circular rosettes) are scattered non-uniformly, with localized clusters in the distal regions of both lobes and the medial span of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 22 degrees and a depth ratio of 1:8 relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-4 pixel depth) visible along the entire trailing edge. Notched irregularities are more frequent on the outer distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curve from the median notch extending toward the tips, where the trajectory transitions to a sharper upward concavity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed white circular pixel clusters (ring scars) varying in diameter from 5 to 15 pixels. High concentration on the distal right lobe and the interior-medial section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast linear disruptions are visible in the central-left quadrant, though partially obscured by the high-contrast circular scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular scarring consistent with historical parasite or barnacle attachment; right fluke tip exhibits a more irregular, ragged pixel boundary compared to the left.
